rule: Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged. The text field must always contain exactly four sentences of 12 to 18 words each. Drop the first sentence, shift sentences 2, 3, and 4 up one position, and write a new fourth sentence describing the concrete physical consequence that occurs when the object in the old first sentence collides with the action in the old third sentence.
text: The tide came in an hour early and covered the flat rock where the mussel bucket stood. Marit checked the table nailed inside the bait shop door and found the paper unchanged. A gull dropped a crab onto the breakwater and the shell broke on the wet stone. The ferry sounded its horn twice out beyond the point where the lighthouse stood dark.
